Overwatch’s next big story begins with the Reign of Talon - Season 1: Conquest.

Fallen City Brawl is bringing hard-hitting, old-school arcade action to PlayStation 5 in physical form later in 2026.

Published by SelectaPlay and developed by Fallen City Studio, this no-holds-barred beat ’em up is inspired by the golden age of arcade brawlers, featuring crunchy pixel art, brutal street combat, and pure side-scrolling mayhem that feels right at home on disc.

Two physical editions are available for PS5:
Standard Edition includes the full game on disc with striking character artwork.

Limited Special Edition is built for collectors and includes a premium collector’s box with exclusive artwork, the physical game, an iron-on patch, the original soundtrack on CD digipack, a lenticular arcade joystick keychain, and a character sticker pack. Quantities are strictly limited.

Battle through seven arcade-inspired stages with deep hand-to-hand combat, devastating combos, RIOT supers, and a ferocious wolf companion at your side.
title: Fallen City Brawl - Official Trailer | PS5 Games

Sir Solomon and the saviors of light depart Castle Cornelius to free Princess Tsuna from the grasp of the evil Devil Lord! But the knight is worried... What if after being freed, the princess falls in love with one of his friends instead of with him? So he does what anyone would do when blinded by love, and ditches his friends! Solomon ventures into the Devil Lord's castle alone, vowing to make the princess his.

Lovish blends tight, bite-sized action with wild surprises, absurd humor, and pure retro spirit. Every room conquered brings Sir Solomon closer to Princess Tsuna… and farther down a reckless path paved with love. With randomized events, strange encounters, and more secrets than a lovesick knight can handle, Lovish is a pixelated romance spiraling gloriously out of control.

Out now on PS5!

About Crimson Desert  
Crimson Desert is an open-world action-adventure game developed by Pearl Abyss. A devastating ambush in the deep of night by their sworn enemies the Black Bears leaves members of the Greymanes dead or scattered across the continent. The Greymane Kliff is determined to reunite with his surviving comrades and rebuild what was lost. But on a journey where alliances are forged, dangers abound, and mysterious factions are uncovered, Kliff comes to realize that an unprecedented threat and a destiny greater than he imagined await him.
